name: Reincarnated Oracle
summary: (Samsaran Only) A reincarnated oracle draws her knowledge and power from the experiences of her previous lives.
replacesText: Oracle’s Curse; Bonus Spells; 1st, 3rd, or 7th-level Revelations (must pick two)

features.name: Oracle’s Curse
features.summary: A reincarnated oracle must choose the haunted or tongues curse at 1st level.

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.summary: see alignment (2nd), detect thoughts (4th), contact other plane (10th), moment of prescience (16th), overwhelming presence (18th). These spells replace the oracle’s mystery bonus spells at these levels.

features.name: Revelations
features.summary: A reincarnated oracle must take the following revelations at one of the listed levels. Location Memories (Su) : As a swift action, you may search your past lives for memories of or insight about your current location. This grants you the scent ability, low-light vision, and a +2 insight bonus on Perception and Survival checks for 1 minute. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. You must take this revelation at 1st level or 3rd level. Spirit Memories (Su) : Once per day, you call upon the unfulfilled desires and goals of your past lives and project their frustration and despair through your eyes at a target. This is a gaze attack affecting one creature. The target must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier) or be sickened and staggered for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting compulsion effect. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. You must take this revelation at 1st, 3rd, or 7th level.
